description: This file defines the 'XorBinary' class used for representing the 'xor' binary operation within the Twig templating engine's abstract syntax tree (AST). It extends an abstract binary node class and provides the specific operator implementation.

classes.name: XorBinary
classes.description: Represents an 'xor' binary operation node in Twig's AST, used during compilation and rendering of templates.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the compiler code for the 'xor' binary operator, used during code generation for template compilation.
